Conceptualization: Set the central scientific question while leaving the procedures to someone else
Choose the hypothesis the team will investigate before anyone specifies how to test it
Data curation: Reconcile inconsistent identifiers in measurements collected by other team members
Attach provenance and quality flags to the archive without collecting new observations
Formal analysis: Use a program written by another person to estimate effects and uncertainty from the observations
Interpret fitted coefficients without changing the analysis code or designing the study
Funding acquisition: Obtain the sponsor's grant without supplying equipment or conducting the work
Secure the external award that paid for access to the research facility
Investigation: Carry out the prescribed measurements rather than cleaning the resulting data file
Run the planned field protocol and record observations without designing the protocol
Methodology: Translate the agreed hypothesis into a defensible identification strategy without choosing the question
Design the sampling and control plan while leaving data collection to other team members
Project administration: Track milestones and resolve scheduling dependencies while someone else provides scientific oversight
Coordinate handoffs between work packages without supervising the technical judgments
Resources: Provide access to the instrument purchased with a grant obtained by another researcher
Supply the specialized reference materials without securing the project budget
Software: Build the program that estimates the effect while leaving interpretation to the analysts
Implement and debug the data-processing pipeline without curating the underlying records
Supervision: Mentor investigators and review the quality of their work while another person handles scheduling
Oversee the research staff and advise on their decisions without managing the project timetable
Validation: Check the existing estimates against an independent rerun without fitting a new primary model
Test whether the reported result replicates using the original procedure on separate data
Visualization: Turn results prepared by the analysts into a figure without rewriting the manuscript
Develop the chart layout that explains the finding without estimating the result
Writing \u2013 original draft: Write the first manuscript from notes supplied by others before any editorial review
Produce the initial paper narrative while colleagues prepare the figures and subsequent revisions
Writing \u2013 review & editing: Revise the arguments and wording of a complete manuscript written by someone else
Critically edit the existing article draft without composing its initial text
